re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +370
- **Deletions**: -51
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T13:12:36Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T13:12:36Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

{
  "key": "gh-1045",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "[rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind",
    "description": "## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39129446238) · started 12:57 · done 13:11 ✅"
  }

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

{
  "key": "gh-1045",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "[rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind",
    "description": "## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39129446238) · started 12:57 · done 13:11 ✅"
  }
}

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)

The "crap" check is the CRAP (Change Risk Anti-Pattern) quality gate — cyclomatic complexity × (1 - coverage) metric. It fails when a function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD=8 for new/renamed code, or regresses vs baseline.

So the failing "crap" check on commit 73679c64 likely flags a function in the new/changed code whose CRAP exceeds the threshold. The new functions here: `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed`, `fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`, `extractGithubCheckRunId`, `detectFailedChecks` (modified — got bigger!). `detectFailedChecks` was likely already in baseline; it's now longer which could raise its CRAP score. New functions with try/catch + branches: fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed has 4-5 branches, complexity maybe 8-10. CRAP = complexity² × (1-coverage fraction)... CRAP = CC × (1 - cov)²... Actually CRAP metric: CRAP = CC(C)² × (1 - cov/100)³ + CC(C). With full coverage of these functions in tests, CRAP is low. The tests cover these paths decently.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +370
- **Deletions**: -51
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T13:12:36Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

## Machine jobs

  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)

re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. - **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +370
- **Deletions**: -51
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T13:12:36Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +370
- **Deletions**: -51
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T13:12:36Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1047
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1047
- **Title**: gh-1045 [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1045` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +370
- **Deletions**: -51
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:26Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-18T13:12:36Z

## PR Description

Closes #1045
## gh-1045: ci_failures_full.log silently missing for bare check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs

### Root Cause
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js` `fetchGithubCheckLogs()` resolved logs from only two `details_url` shapes: `/jobs/{id}` and `/actions/runs/{id}`. A bare check-run URL (`github.com/o/runs/{id}`) matched the generic `/runs/{id}` pattern, so the **check-run id was misrouted to the workflow-run API** (`github_get_workflow_run_jobs`), resolved nothing, and failed silently — no marker in `ci_failures.md`, none in the full log.
- `ci_failures_full.log` was only written when ≥1 check produced logs, while `buildCiFailuresHeader()` advertised it unconditionally — the exact INPUTS lie from the dmtools-dart PR #423 incident.

### Previous Attempt
- gh-982 added the `/actions/runs/N` workflow-run fallback but never handled the *bare* check-run shape; `extractGithubRunId` matches both shapes and misroutes the check-run id. No prior gh-1045 fix existed.

### Fix
- `js/common/githubHelpers.js`:
  - New `extractGithubCheckRunId()` + `fetchGithubCheckLogsDetailed()`: bare `/runs/{id}` → the id IS a check-run id; job log fetched directly (Actions job-log endpoints accept check-run ids). `/actions/runs/{id}` keeps the existing gh-982 run-jobs path.
  - Loud resolvers (`fetchGithubRunLogsDetailed`, `fetchJenkinsCheckLogsDetailed`) return `{logs}` or `{reason}`; a check with no logs gets `log fetch failed: <reason>` in `ci_failures.md` and a `=== LOG FETCH FAILED for: <name> ===` marker in `ci_failures_full.log`.
  - `ci_failures_full.log` is now always written when failed checks exist (fetched logs + per-check error markers), written BEFORE `ci_failures.md`; header/resolution sections take a `hasFullLog` flag — the md never references the file when its write failed (AC2).

### Test Coverage
- New suite in `js/unit-tests/test_githubHelpers.js` (gh-1045): mixed URL shapes replay of the #423 head (3 checks: actions-job URL + 2 bare check-run URLs, one fetch failing) — full log has both real logs + per-check diagnostics, zero workflow-run-jobs calls; one check's fetch failure does not drop other logs; SCM mode; `extractGithubCheckRunId` shape matrix; AC2 no-reference-on-write-failure.
- Updated 6 pre-existing tests that pinned the old silent contract to the loud one.
- Reproduction tests written first and confirmed RED; full suite: **4133 passed, 0 failed** (`dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).

### Notes
- No new dmtools tools required — reuses `github_get_job_logs` / `scm.getJobLogs`, which accept check-run ids.
- `buildReworkStartedComment` (tracker comment) still mentions `ci_failures_full.log`; with the always-write-when-failures behavior the file now exists whenever that comment fires, so no change needed there.

# gh-1045: [rework] ci_failures_full.log silently missing when failed checks have check-run (runs/NNN) details URLs — rework legs fly blind

## Description

## Live evidence (2026-10-18, dmtools-dart PR #423, run 39128203443/job/117678110540)

Rework leg input prep wrote `input/gh-396/ci_failures.md` listing **5 failed checks** and telling the agent "Full (untruncated) logs are available in \`ci_failures_full.log\`" — the INPUTS manifest also advertises `ci_failures_full.log`. **The file was never written.** The leg probed `test -f input/gh-396/ci_failures_full.log` → absent → the leg reported "The logs are still absent, and I have no new code information" and closed without a code change. This repeated across at least 3 legs (threads 3/6/7 in the PR all say "ci_failures_full.log is not in the input"), and the gh-957 no-op-loop guard eventually withheld the arm — the PR burned days on legs that literally could not see what to fix.

## Root cause hypothesis

The failing checks on that head had mixed details-URL shapes:

- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/runs/117677625675` — bare check-run URL (gate/static/agents-gate)
- `https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/actions/runs/39127338030/job/117677126855` — actions job URL (gate, test (0))

The full-log fetcher appears to resolve logs only from actions job URLs (or aborts the whole full-log write when any entry is not resolvable) and the failure is silent: no warning in ci_failures.md, no fallback, no marker. In the dmtools-agents repo legs the failed checks had actions-job URLs and `ci_failures_full.log` WAS written — so the bare check-run shape is the differentiator.

## Fix

1. Resolve job logs for bare check-run URLs too (check-run → its actions job via the check-run API, or `gh api repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs/{id}` → details → job log endpoint).
2. Fail LOUD, not silent: if a failed check's log cannot be fetched, `ci_failures.md` must say so per-check ("log fetch failed: <reason>") and still write `ci_failures_full.log` with whatever was fetched plus per-check error markers. Never advertise a file in INPUTS that was not written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replaying the #423 head state (5 failed checks, mixed URL shapes) produces a `ci_failures_full.log` containing log content for the actions-job checks AND per-check fetch diagnostics for the rest.
- [ ] `ci_failures.md` never references `ci_failures_full.log` when the file was not written.
- [ ] Unit tests: mixed URL shapes; fetch failure of one check does not drop the other logs.

        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true

          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure

          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then

re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass.
